tips.text: Abort right after a correct-Antivirus stab; the disinfection banks immediately, but Quick Correct Heartcells and bounty rewards are lost.
Equip three different Antivirus mods per stab; all three are tested at once, so you find the right one in three Duets at most.
Buy the first roll Eleanor shows instead of waiting for a better one; any copy beats none and one later fusion fixes the percentage.
Vanquish the Coda; converting pays no Live Heartcells and the weapon is bought with them.
Bring Revenant with Mesmer Skin or Nyx with Absorb to be immune to the stage hazards; Rhino, Titania and Dante's overguard also carry the fight.
Run the Antivirus Bounty on Steel Path; it stacks Antivirus mods, the largest Hex standing and Duet disinfection progress.
Run the Concert solo to finish in about 5 to 7 minutes, or bring a squad for one extra Live Heartcell per Coda at the cost of a longer fight.
Host the Concert or run it solo; non-host players often see the stage hazards desynced or invisible.
Skip shield-gating builds for the Concert; the Coda's Toxin bypasses shields and shield gating.
Equip two 15% Potency mods such as Immuno Shield and Instant Secure once you know the Antivirus; that is up to 35% a stab.
In a public squad, stab your own Coda promptly even with the wrong mods; other players' Duets cannot spawn until you do.
Do not wait for an element; Elemental Vice lets you swap it permanently once the weapon is rank 40.
Kill DJ RoM first in a Duet; his Toxin bypasses shields and shield gates.
Use a fast frame such as Titania, Volt, Gauss or Wukong for the spawn runs.
Equip Quick Correct only on the stab that finishes the Coda; it is the one Potency mod that can drop Live Heartcells.
The Coda hunt is by far the least painful adversary system, with no punishment for a wrong Antivirus guess.
Coda Bubonico is rated just behind Coda Bassocyst, though its 7-shot spool-up is the loudest complaint.
